FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Everything You Need to Know

What is AI motion transfer and how does Genjutsu AI work? +

Upload a character image and choose a built-in dance reference. AI applies the reference motion to your character; details and movement can vary.

How is Genjutsu AI different from generic face swap apps? +

Motion transfer animates the body from a reference performance. It is different from replacing only a face in an existing clip.

Does it work with anime, 3D avatars, and illustrated art? +

You can use human photos, anime illustrations or 3D character images. Use a clear single character; complex poses and fine details can be less consistent.

What kind of photos work best? +

Use a clear image showing one character’s head, torso and preferably full body. JPEG, PNG or WebP, at least 320 pixels per side, up to 4 megapixels and 8 MB.

Can I upload my own custom dance or workout video? +

This release offers two built-in 10-second motion references: Hip-Hop and K-Pop. Custom reference video upload is not available.

What output format and resolution do I receive? +

A 10-second 720p MP4 based on the selected vertical reference. Music and audio are not guaranteed; add licensed sound when posting if needed.

What happens if a video render fails? +

Confirmed failures return one credit. If the provider submission is uncertain, support reviews it before resubmitting. Successful renders are not refunded automatically for subjective preferences.

Do you own the rights to the videos you generate? +

Use images you own or have permission to use, and get the depicted person’s consent. Generated media does not grant rights to third-party characters, music or source material.
